mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.name, c.pic_url, c.sort_order, c.status, c.is_deleted, c.create_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM promotion_article a WHERE a.category_id = c.id AND a.is_deleted = 0) AS article_count FROM promotion_article_category c WHERE c.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.sort_order ASC, c.id ASC
SELECT id, name, pic_url, sort_order, status, is_deleted, create_time FROM promotion_article_category WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO promotion_article_category (name, pic_url, sort_order, status, is_deleted, create_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{picUrl}, #{sortOrder}, #{status}, 0, #{createTime})
mapper.update:
UPDATE promotion_article_category
name = #{name}, pic_url = #{picUrl}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, status = #{status}, update_time = #{updateTime},
WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
